headline: Suzhou Nichirin Automobile Parts Co., Ltd. Hit by Ransomware, Shuts Down Production Systems
body: Suzhou Nichirin Automobile Parts Co., Ltd., a prominent automotive components supplier, announced today that it has been targeted by a ransomware attack. The cyber incident forced the company to shut down its production control systems, prompting a shift to manual operations. While other units remain unaffected, Suzhou Nichirin Automobile Parts Co., Ltd. has warned its contacts about potential fraudulent messages. The company has engaged cybersecurity experts to handle the situation and is working diligently to restore normal operations.
